subject.title: feat(gateway): add opt-in WebChat OpenResponses progress event

question: What public config/API surface should own WebChat OpenResponses progress: a supported Gateway/OpenResponses config path, or a restored `gateway.webchat` namespace?
rationale: Current main intentionally retired `gateway.webchat`, so merging this PR as written would create a documented option that doctor currently removes.

options.title: Use Supported Gateway/OpenResponses Config
options.body: Move the opt-in under a non-retired Gateway/OpenResponses path and keep `gateway.webchat` retired.

options.title: Restore WebChat Config Deliberately
options.body: Keep the PR's namespace only if docs, doctor migration behavior, config reference, and tests are updated to make `gateway.webchat` public again.

options.title: Pause This Contract
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and close or defer this branch until maintainers choose the progress-event contract.

recommendation.title: Use Supported Gateway/OpenResponses Config
recommendation.body: Move the opt-in under a non-retired Gateway/OpenResponses path and keep `gateway.webchat` retired.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current `gateway.webchat` retirement and doctor migration behavior that determines whether this namespace can be restored.
